description: What happened with one contact, newest first, a page at a time: when it was added (and by which import), each import that changed it (`import_updated`), the campaigns it joined and left, each address check, every campaign or direct email to it with its bounce or spam report, the first time a person opened each email (`opened`, with how many opens) and clicked each link in it (`clicked`, with the page and the link's words), the mail it sent to your mailboxes, the mail your team wrote to it in their own mail app (`outside_email`: the subject, the mailbox and the thread, never the body), and its changes on the suppression list, with the day a lifted row went on when the lift recorded it. An email sent through colding is only ever listed once. Opens and clicks by mail scanners and image proxies are never in it, and neither is warmup mail. Each event has a `type`; the fields beside it depend on the type. A contact in another workspace answers 404.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_contact_timeline
title: Get a contact's history
